description: Make several runs of a TAU with one call, each leaving what it makes in a folder of its own, and keep the best.

tau.description: The TAU to run: its folder, which a caller gives as an extra in file, named here as "${name}".

call.description: The call to make: each path names a file given as an extra file, as "${name}", and a placeholder meant for the TAU's agent takes one $ more, as "$${name}".

judge.description: What makes a run the best.
